4 /-! For a source sharing a face with every original vertex, the star
5 cuts are simply the straight segments from the source to those vertices. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 /-- The straight source-to-vertex cuts, viewed on the actual boundary. -/
12 def starCuts (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) : Set (frontier P.body) :=
13   {b | ∃ v : P.Vertex, (b : Space) ∈ segment ℝ (a : Space) (v : Space)}
14 
15 /-- The actual boundary after removing those cut rays. -/
16 abbrev UncutSurface (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) :=
17   {b : frontier P.body // b ∉ P.starCuts a}
18 
19 theorem source_mem_starCuts (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) : a ∈ P.starCuts a := by
20   obtain ⟨v, member⟩ := P.vertices_nonempty
21   exact ⟨⟨v, member⟩, left_mem_segment ℝ _ _⟩
22 
23 theorem starCuts_closed (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) : IsClosed (P.starCuts a) := by
24   have description : P.starCuts a = ⋃ v : P.Vertex,
25       (fun b : frontier P.body => (b : Space)) ⁻¹' segment ℝ (a : Space) (v : Space) := by
26     ext b
27     simp only [starCuts, mem_setOf_eq, mem_iUnion, mem_preimage]
28   rw [description]
29   apply isClosed_iUnion_of_finite
30   intro v
31   have compact : IsCompact (segment ℝ (a : Space) (v : Space)) := by
32     rw [segment_eq_image_lineMap]
33     apply isCompact_Icc.image
34     fun_prop
35   exact compact.isClosed.preimage continuous_subtype_val
36 
37 /-- Every shortest ray to an original cofacial vertex lies in the stated straight cut. -/
38 theorem original_route_subset_starCuts (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : frontier P.body)
39     (original : (b : Space) ∈ P.vertices) (F : P.Face) (source : (a : Space) ∈ F.val)
40     (target : (b : Space) ∈ F.val) (route : P.BoundaryCurve) (member : route ∈ P.geodesicFiber a b) :
41     range route ⊆ P.starCuts a := by
42   obtain ⟨path, shortest, _, _, same⟩ := P.geodesicFiber_path a b route member
43   rintro x ⟨t, rfl⟩
44   refine ⟨⟨b, original⟩, ?_⟩
45   have inside := path.shortest_cofacial_range_subset shortest F source target ⟨t, rfl⟩
46   rw [← same]
47   exact inside
48 
49 namespace PlacedCutEdgeTriangles
50 
51 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
52     {u v : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v} (D : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge)
53 
54 /-- A represented endpoint ray outside the star cuts cannot end at an original vertex. -/
55 theorem endpoint_nonvertex_of_outside_cuts
56     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
57     {b : frontier P.body} {x : Plane} (outside : b ∉ P.starCuts a)
58     (placed : D.PlacesOnRay 0 b x) : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices := by
59   intro original
60   obtain ⟨F, source, target⟩ := cofacial ⟨u, original⟩
61   obtain ⟨side, t, at_point, _⟩ := placed
62   apply outside
63   apply P.original_route_subset_starCuts a (T.vertexTarget u) original F source target (D.routes side 0)
64   · simpa only [T.closedEdgeTarget_zero] using D.routes_member side 0
65   · exact ⟨t, at_point⟩
66 
67 end PlacedCutEdgeTriangles
68 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
